description: This file defines an internal readonly struct 'StateEntity' which manages and serializes transaction state data, including interactions with Azure Table Storage entities, serialization/deserialization of state JSON, and storage size management.

classes.name: StateEntity
classes.description: An internal, readonly struct encapsulating Azure Table Storage entity behavior for transaction state, including serialization, deserialization, size checking, and property management.

methods.name: MakeRowKey
methods.description: Constructs a row key string from a sequence ID, formatted as a hexadecimal string with prefix.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new StateEntity instance from a pending transaction state, serializing relevant info and setting state.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Deserializes and returns the stored state object of type T from the JSON stored in the entity.

methods.name: SetState
methods.description: Serializes a given state object into JSON and stores it within the entity's properties.
